intro: The white salt desert under a full moon. That is Rann of Kutch in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Rann of Kutch
paragraphs: Rann of Kutch (Gujarat) is known for its desert, culture and adventure experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February.
